runs.t: Supports blast and ballistics performance requirements — ideal for government, defense, and mission-critical facilities.

Custom-made forms create concrete panels in precise dimensions and shapes. Reveals, joints, patterns, and other expressive detailing are introduced at the panel surface — all in the factory, before delivery to site.

Specific color effects are achieved through varying sands, aggregates, and pigments. Stone, tile, or brick veneers can be attached, cast into, or replicated in architectural precast panels at the plant — allowing dramatic aesthetic effects at minimal additional cost.
Navy Administration Building — complex panel geometry with embedded masonry detailing meeting federal security requirements.
Landmark mixed-use tower featuring distinctive multi-color precast panels that define the Oakland skyline.
Architectural precast delivering a contextually sensitive facade that reflects the industrial heritage of West Oakland.
Our facade specialists work with your team from schematic design to deliver architectural precast panels that achieve your vision — on schedule and on budget.
Clark Pacific is a leading manufacturer of prefabricated building systems. We are transforming design and construction by delivering high-quality, cost-effective buildings with less risk.
